message: 僕らの学園は戦場だった

name: Pasta
message: 「Grrr. Pretty cocky for a bunch of humans, nya...」
We were standing.
Pasta was down on her knees.
The demons surrounding the plaza stood in silence.

name: Synn
message: 「Pasta... What is your objective?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Like I'd ever tell you that, nya!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In situations like this, it is apparently customary to torture them into confessing. I hear there are various methods, such as Tibetan torture or stone-hugging.」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa, sounds fun! Let me do it!」

name: Pasta
message: 「I-I won't yield to threats like that, nya!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Torture... We can't do something like that. Interrogation is the most we can manage.」

name: Misa
message: 「In this situation... even interrogation is out of the question.」
Even though we had defeated Pasta and her executives, there was no telling what would happen if the demons surrounding the plaza decided to attack.
On top of that, maybe because the tension finally broke, Shio-chan had even passed out.

name: Pasta
message: 「We're pulling back for today, nya. Next time we meet will be the end of you, nya!」
In response to her voice, about ten of the demons surrounding the plaza gathered around Pasta and her royal guard, supporting them as they prepared to retreat.

name: Synn
message: 「Are you quitting Prier?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya?」

name: Synn
message: 「If you suddenly quit Prier, a lot of people are going to be in trouble.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Quit or not, I can't stay there anymore, nya. You guys are just gonna get Pasta fired, nya!」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't have to quit. I'll try asking Helena-san not to fire you.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun! What are you saying?!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Yeah, nya! What are you saying, nya?!」

name: Synn
message: 「You guys aren't attacking the students, and you aren't destroying any property.」

name: Ria
message: 「Come to think of it... that's true.」

name: Synn
message: 「On the other hand, if you didn't have some kind of goal, there's no way you'd be acting so orderly.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn actually sounds smart for once.」

name: Synn
message: 「That just makes it even more confusing. Why are they hanging around after school?」

name: Sally
message: 「There's no way they have a goal or anything. They're demons, after all. They probably just have too much free time.」

name: Pasta
message: 「A low-level demon like you could never understand the thoughts of Bylous-nyama-nya!」

name: Synn
message: 「Bylous-nyama-nya?」

name: Pasta
message: 「F-Forget I just said that-nya! Retreat-nya!」

name: Cat Demon
message: 「Meow!」
Like a receding tide, the demons retreat.
We didn't have the strength left to pursue them.

name: Synn
message: 「Somehow, it's over...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「'Bylous-nyama' sounds like someone from Central or South America.」

name: Ria
message: 「I think 'nyama' was probably supposed to be 'sama,' wasn't it?」

name: Sally
message: 「Bylous... I feel like I've heard that somewhere... V-i-r-u-s... Hmm.」

name: Sally
message: 「Ah, I remembered! Pretty sure he's one of the Seven Demon Generals.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come to think of it, I feel like Eauderourke was called something like that too.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sally. If you know, tell us the names of all seven of them.」

name: Sally
message: 「No way, bleh. What's with that bossy attitude?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Sally-chan. Could you tell us the names of the Seven Demon Generals, just the ones you know?」

name: Sally
message: 「Let's see... Boss, Pasta from just now, and then Bylous, and...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't keep us in suspense, tell us the other four too!」

name: Sally
message: 「I don't know them. Aside from Bylous, the others aren't really that famous.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, that's about as much as you can expect from a little girl.」

name: Synn
message: 「Too bad.」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, being that exceptionally famous means he must be strong. Undoubtedly.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even if you say he's strong, he's still just a demon, you know. They're way weaker than angels.」

name: Sally
message: 「From what I've heard, Bylous once picked a fight with the angel and the demon rumored to be the strongest, and took them both down at the exact same time.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek! Even an angel?! B-But that has to be just a rumor. There's no way an angel could lose to a demon. Right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Even if you ask me that, I don't know what to tell you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So a demon like that has come here to Ryuusei Town?」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you think he's trying to take over this world after all?」

name: Sally
message: 「Like I said, he wouldn't bother with anything that troublesome.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Probably not.」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, it's certain that he has ties to Pasta. And judging from what he said, Bylous is the mastermind plotting something.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I really wish we could've at least interrogated her.」

name: Ria
message: 「It's okay. I think we still have a chance.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why's that?」

name: Ria
message: 「You stopped her at the end, didn't you, Synn?」

name: Ria
message: 「So, it's just a maybe, but she might keep working as a waitress. I'll ask my big sister to let her keep the waitress job, too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Way to go, Ria. Planning to get close to her and draw out information, huh? Makes me fall for you all over again.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's what you were thinking too, right, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? N-No, I just thought a lot of people would be in a bind if she suddenly quit Prier... Besides, I don't think she's really a bad person.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well... she doesn't really seem like the scheming type.」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder if she'll actually show up, though?」
